whyWatch.body:
The World Cup is free on Tubi this summer. Not a trial, not a promo, not another subscription to remember.

This is the first 48-team World Cup, with 3 host nations and 104 matches across the tournament. Tubi has the live US group opener, the Mexico opener, VOD replays for both, and an exclusive documentary series that gets you close to the players before the first whistle blows. If you want the story before the stakes, McKennie's episode is already there.

Start with Destination World Cup 2026 today, visit the hub now at tubitv.com/hubs/fifa-world-cup-fox-hub, and set a reminder for June 11 at 1 PM CT and June 12 at 6 PM PT. The USMNT hasn't played a home World Cup match in 32 years. This one is free on an app that's probably already on your TV.

items.heading: The hub is live now
items.paragraph: The World Cup hub is live now at tubitv.com/hubs/fifa-world-cup-fox-hub and runs through July 19. It pulls together Fox Sports VOD, tournament clips, linear programming, and Tubi's World Cup coverage in one place, so you can move from the stories behind the players to the matches themselves without hunting around.

items.heading: Mexico vs. South Africa, June 11, 1:00 PM CT
items.paragraph: Group A opens in Mexico City with Mexico playing in front of a home crowd that will make the atmosphere feel like anything but a neutral venue. South Africa comes in with a real chance to make that opener uncomfortable, which is exactly what makes first matches worth watching. Stream it live on Tubi with a free account.

items.heading: USA vs. Paraguay, June 12, 6:00 PM PT
items.paragraph: The USMNT plays its first World Cup match on home soil since 1994 at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood. Paraguay is a serious opening test, and the US squad brings Weston McKennie, Ricardo Pepi, and Sergiño Dest into a match that already feels bigger than a group stage opener should. Fox pregame and post-game coverage are included.

items.heading: VOD replays, no account required
items.paragraph: Miss the live match? The full 90-minute replay goes up within 1 to 2 hours after the final whistle. No sign-in required, no subscription needed. Pregame and post-game coverage are not included, but the full match is there when you're ready for it.
